basic_identification.full_title: SPECIFICATION FOR HARD METAL BURRS — PART 9 : 60° AND 90° CONE BURRS (TYPE J AND K)

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the dimensions and other requirements of hard metal burrs of 60° cone, Type J and 90° cone, Type K.

requirements.detail: Defines two conical profiles based on angular shape (α): Type J representing 60° cone burrs, and Type K representing 90° cone burrs.
Prescribes standard nominal head diameters (d) as: 3 mm, 6 mm, 10 mm, 12 mm, and 15 mm.

Establishes calculated cutting length limits (l) in millimetres per nominal diameter (d): 
a) For 60° Cone (Type J): d=3 (2.6 mm), d=6 (5.2 mm), d=10 (8.7 mm), d=12 (10.4 mm), d=15 (13.6 mm). 
b) For 90° Cone (Type K): d=3 (1.5 mm), d=6 (1 mm), d=10 (5 mm), d=12 (6 mm), d=15 (8 mm).

For any mechanical, material, or testing requirements not explicitly covered by this part, the burrs must comply with Part 1 of the standard (typographically printed in Clause 3 as S : 11948 (Part 1) - 1987).
Requires each burr to be legibly and durably marked with its specific designation code and the manufacturer's name or registered trade-mark.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 11943 (Part 9) : 1987 is the national Indian Standard specification governing 60° cone (Type J) and 90° cone (Type K) hard metal burrs. First published in 1987 and reaffirmed in 2003, it establishes dimensional limits (diameters 3 mm to 15 mm) and calculated cutting lengths for both angular types. To ensure manufacturing quality and material consistency, it mandates that all supply parameters, testing, and inspection conditions conform to Part 1 of the standard (IS 11943 Part 1 / typographically cited in Clause 3 as IS 11948 Part 1) and requires each burr to carry its specific designation code and manufacturer mark.
